issue.title: Fix memory markdown formatting that blocks just check
issue.description: Reproduction: running `just check` fails at the markdown formatting gate before code lint/tests because Prettier reports `sase/memory/build_and_run.md` is not formatted. Impact: every agent sees `just check` fail before the scoped verification lane. Scope: with explicit user permission for a memory edit, apply Prettier-compatible wrapping to `sase/memory/build_and_run.md`, then run `sase memory init` so generated instruction shims stay synchronized. Evidence: file:explicit:a55b65162b2a5af4be606810.

evidence.note: Independent reproduction on 2026-08-09 during unrelated dev_update execute.py module-split verification: just check rebuilt sase_core_rs, then failed at fmt-md-check because Prettier reported sase/memory/build_and_run.md. git status and git diff confirmed the protected memory note is unmodified by this change; the failure prevents the required scoped test lane from starting.

Independent reproduction on 2026-08-09 during unrelated dev_update env-overlay verification: after a clean just install and focused tests passing, just check stopped at fmt-md-check because node_modules/.bin/prettier --check **/*.md reported [warn] sase/memory/build_and_run.md and exited before lint or scoped tests. The working tree changes are in dev_update/ACE test code, not the protected memory note.
